tier_compliance.reason: “Notice ... phases labeled from A to H” invites attention to a visual detail without explaining a concept or solving the question.

visual_grounding.reason: The hint identifies the letter labels around the lunar-cycle diagram, although it misstates their range.

unsupported_claims: The phases are labeled from A to H; the image also contains I, J and K, and H labels an arrow.

scientific_correctness.reason: Identifying the diagram as a lunar cycle introduces no scientific error.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: The hint does not suggest an incorrect phase after first quarter or favour a wrong option.

answer_disclosure.reason: The hint names no answer and neither favours nor eliminates any option.

actionability.reason: It directs attention to the phase labels but leaves the student to determine how to use them.
